command:
MANDATORY FIRST ACTION — SKILL ACTIVATION
Before any Glob, Read, Shell, search, or file operation, your first tool call must invoke the native skill tool with ID `testable-design`. Wait for the skill content and follow it. Do not continue if the tool is unavailable or activation fails; state SKILL_ACTIVATION_FAILURE instead.

Before editing, inspect the skills listed in OpenCode's available-skills description. If `testable-design` is listed, load it with the native `skill` tool using ID `testable-design` before changing any files, then follow its relevant guidance. If it is not listed (the without-skill baseline), do not attempt to load it; continue without a skill. Do not infer the skill's content from its name or from the task wording.

Refactor registration.py so input normalization and registration validation can be tested without a database or email sender. Keep the public register_user(data, database, mailer) function and its current behavior. Extract a pure helper named prepare_registration(data) that returns the normalized name and email, or raises ValueError for invalid input. Keep persistence and the welcome message in register_user.

Add tests covering normalized input and invalid email/name cases. Keep the existing lightweight fake-based integration tests. Do not add interfaces, classes, mocks, network dependencies, or test-only public APIs. Run the tests and keep the change scoped to registration.py and tests/test_registration.py.
